exclusions.reason: Package/workflow prose is context, not a product capability.
Historical release prose is not current feature source.
Generated declarations, caches and temporary proof outputs are not editable feature source.
Static build output, nested proof working copies and stress artifacts; source and runner contracts are inventoried instead.

inventory.boundary: All package source, exports and proof/config inputs; full copied registry; Plite proof host; editor benchmark and distribution/proof tooling. Product marketing pages, generated public registry output, templates, dependency/vendor trees and historical artifact corpora are excluded; their editable feature source is covered. The canonical PLUGINS catalog contributes one explicit member per declared first-party capability, including marks/styles hidden inside shared source files; literal consumers are source observations, not reachability proof.
